scenarios.deterministicReason: Fresh and seeded isolated profiles define every startup state.
evidenceConstraints: Record lifecycle states and stable build identity only

scenarios.deterministicReason: A versioned Project fixture fixes roots, links, files, and Git state.
evidenceConstraints: Record logical file and Git projections without source contents

scenarios.deterministicReason: A fresh profile and fixed identifiers make Session transitions repeatable.
evidenceConstraints: Record logical Session state without Agent transcripts

scenarios.deterministicReason: A seeded Workbench projection fixes pane, document, and selection state.
evidenceConstraints: Record document identity and dirty state without source text

scenarios.deterministicReason: A fixture shell emits declared markers and exits with fixed statuses.
evidenceConstraints: Record marker fingerprints and lifecycle state, never Terminal output

scenarios.deterministicReason: A repository-owned fake Agent fixes launch, activity, and failure sequences.
evidenceConstraints: Record activity and binding metadata without prompts or transcripts

scenarios.deterministicReason: Bundled fixture extensions declare fixed activation and contribution outcomes.
evidenceConstraints: Record contribution identifiers and stable error families only

scenarios.deterministicReason: Structured CLI argv and isolated fixtures produce bounded output contracts.
evidenceConstraints: Record redacted structured output kinds, streams, and exit codes

scenarios.deterministicReason: A fixed request registry and fault injector define every protocol outcome.
evidenceConstraints: Record public command, reply, event, and stable error kinds only

scenarios.deterministicReason: Fixed generations and connection order define lease replacement behavior.
evidenceConstraints: Record public lease state without transport addresses or credentials

scenarios.deterministicReason: Versioned seed data and a logical exporter fix persisted domain projections.
evidenceConstraints: Record logical projections, never database rows or user content

scenarios.deterministicReason: Fixed invalid inputs and race hooks reproduce each security rejection.
evidenceConstraints: Record denial category and remediation without secret-bearing inputs

scenarios.deterministicReason: Fault injection fixes disconnect, reload, stale build, and crash sequences.
evidenceConstraints: Record user-visible recovery states and data-preservation projections

scenarios.deterministicReason: A fixed viewport, theme, font, data fixture, and focus path stabilize the UI.
evidenceConstraints: Record accessibility semantics and reviewed screenshot hashes

scenarios.deterministicReason: Repeated samples on one declared machine support frozen statistical budgets.
evidenceConstraints: Record durations and resource counts outside semantic equality
